info.title: ServiceTrade Universal API
info.description: Field service management platform for commercial contractors. ServiceTrade manages locations, assets, appointments, jobs, service requests, quotes, invoices, users, and webhooks.

post.description: Creates a new asset in ServiceTrade.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

type.description: ServiceTrade asset definition type to create, such as location or grease_containment.

locationId.description: Location that will own the new asset.

properties.notes.description: Notes property for asset definitions that support it.

taskListId.description: Task list to attach to the new asset.
